name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
summary: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is a veteran dwarven engineer stationed atop the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan. Tasked with the upkeep and defense of this monumental feat of engineering, he oversees its delicate mechanisms while keeping watch for sabotage. Those who speak with him quickly discover that grave dangers threaten the integrity of the great dam.

sections.title: Master of the Dam
sections.body: The Stonewrought Dam is one of the crowning achievements of dwarven stonecraft and engineering, holding back the massive waters of the Loch. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII bears the immense responsibility of maintaining its structure and operational machinery. Perched along the crest of the dam, he monitors the waterways, sluice gates, and structural stress points against the elements and local hazards.

sections.title: Sabotage and Subversion
sections.body: Running the dam is more than routine maintenance; dark forces continually test its defenses. Hinderweir uncovers signs of calculated sabotage orchestrated by hostile elements in the region. Aware that a catastrophic breach would flood the lowlands and devastate Khaz Modan's delicate infrastructure, the Chief Engineer enlists reliable Alliance adventurers to trace the conspiracy, disarm hidden explosives, and neutralize the threat before the stone gives way.

faq.q: Who is Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is the dwarven supervisor in charge of maintaining and defending the Stonewrought Dam in northern Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where can I find Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: He can be found standing along the top walkway of the Stonewrought Dam, which spans the northern edge of Loch Modan near the border to the Wetlands.
The Stonewrought Dam is a massive dwarven architectural wonder that holds back the waters of Loch Modan, preventing the lake from violently spilling into the lower wetlands to the north.

faq.q: What threats is Hinderweir worried about?
aliases: who wants to destroy the dam
faq.answer: Hinderweir investigates active sabotage against the dam, discovering evidence of dark plots and explosive devices planted to crack its foundations.
The Roman numeral suggests a proud family lineage of dwarven engineers or architects who have served Khaz Modan over generations.

faq.q: What quests does Chief Engineer Hinderweir offer?
faq.answer: He offers the quest chain 'A Dark Threat Looms', which directs adventurers to investigate tampering and protect the Stonewrought Dam from destruction.

angles.text: For dwarves, Hinderweir represents the solemn duty of preserving Khaz Modan's greatest stonecraft achievements against outside malice.
Engineers can appreciate the sheer mechanical scale of Hinderweir's charge, as the Stonewrought Dam represents a peerless mix of civil architecture and mechanical control.
The Alliance cannot afford to let the dam fall; catastrophic failure would disrupt supply routes and devastate allied lands north of Loch Modan.
